$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: The event type this rule answers, e.g. "attacked", "fed". Unique; stable once shipped.

notes.description: Why this event moves disposition, and by this much.

delta.description: Change in disposition when the event happens (−100..100 scale; the result clamps).

valueTiers.description: Item value tiers that scale `delta` (crime.theft, mw-e22.4): the highest tier whose minValue the item reaches applies; below the first tier, or none listed = ×1. Ascending by minValue.

minValue.description: Item value (gold) at which this tier starts.

scale.description: Multiplier on `delta` for items in this tier.
